settings.support.blurb.original: If you find this plugin useful, consider supporting its development:
settings.support.blurb.translation: Jika plugin ini bermanfaat, pertimbangkan untuk mendukung pengembangannya:

settings.support.mission.original: …and help seed a bigger vision: technology that serves people and planet..
settings.support.mission.translation: …dan bantu menyemai visi yang lebih besar: teknologi yang melayani manusia dan bumi.

settings.templates.templaterFile.desc.original: Path to the templater plugin template file to use
settings.templates.templaterFile.desc.translation: Jalur berkas templat plugin Templater yang akan dipakai

settings.transcripts.info.original: Transcript settings control how and where your extracted notes are saved, which youtube data API key to use (required for channel/playlist processing), and optional language-translation parameters.
settings.transcripts.info.translation: Pengaturan transkrip menentukan bagaimana dan di mana catatan hasil ekstraksi disimpan, kunci YouTube data API mana yang dipakai (wajib untuk memproses kanal dan daftar putar), serta parameter terjemahan yang bersifat opsional.

settings.transcripts.rootFolder.desc.original: The root folder where transcript subfolders will be organized (e.g., inbox, notes, etc.)
settings.transcripts.rootFolder.desc.translation: Folder induk tempat subfolder transkrip ditata (mis. inbox, notes, dsb.)

settings.transcripts.youtubeApiKey.desc.original: Your Google cloud console API key for accessing public YouTube transcripts (not an OAUTH token). Required for downloading channels and playlists.
settings.transcripts.youtubeApiKey.desc.translation: Kunci API Google Cloud Console untuk mengakses transkrip YouTube publik (bukan token OAUTH). Wajib untuk mengunduh kanal dan daftar putar.

settings.transcripts.scrapeCreatorsApiKe.original: Optional key for scrapecreators transcript service. When set, used as the primary transcript method. Get a free key at app.scrapecreators.com (100 requests free). Recommended for reliable transcript retrieval; direct YouTube extraction breaks when YouTube changes how captions are served.
settings.transcripts.scrapeCreatorsApiKe.translation: Kunci opsional untuk layanan transkrip scrapecreators. Jika diisi, dipakai sebagai metode transkrip utama. Dapatkan kunci gratis di app.scrapecreators.com (100 permintaan gratis). Disarankan agar pengambilan transkrip andal; ekstraksi langsung dari YouTube rusak setiap kali YouTube mengubah cara takarir disajikan.

settings.transcripts.supadataApiKey.desc.original: Optional key for supadata transcript service. When set, used as the primary transcript method (if no scrapecreators key). Get a key at supadata.ai.
settings.transcripts.supadataApiKey.desc.translation: Kunci opsional untuk layanan transkrip supadata. Jika diisi, dipakai sebagai metode transkrip utama (bila tidak ada kunci scrapecreators). Dapatkan kunci di supadata.ai.

settings.transcripts.translateLanguage.d.original: Target language code for translation (e.g., en, es, fr, de). Use "en" to keep content in english.
settings.transcripts.translateLanguage.d.translation: Kode bahasa tujuan terjemahan (mis. en, es, fr, de). Gunakan “en” agar isinya tetap berbahasa Inggris.

settings.transcripts.translateCountry.de.original: Target country/region code for translation (e.g., us, gb, ca). Used for region-specific language variants.
settings.transcripts.translateCountry.de.translation: Kode negara/wilayah tujuan terjemahan (mis. us, gb, ca). Dipakai untuk varian bahasa per wilayah.

settings.llm.info.original: Choose an AI provider, enter its API key, and pick a model. Temperature controls creativity; max tokens caps output length. OpenRouter is recommended for reliability; Google's gemini-2.5-flash is cheaper, but its lower-cost tiers can be throttled.
settings.llm.info.translation: Pilih penyedia AI, masukkan kunci API-nya, lalu pilih model. Temperature mengatur kreativitas; max tokens membatasi panjang keluaran. OpenRouter disarankan demi keandalan; gemini-2.5-flash dari Google lebih murah, tetapi paketnya yang murah bisa terkena pembatasan laju.

settings.llm.provider.desc.original: Provider used for summarization. OpenRouter is recommended for reliability; lower-cost Gemini tiers can be throttled.
settings.llm.provider.desc.translation: Penyedia yang dipakai untuk meringkas. OpenRouter disarankan demi keandalan; paket Gemini yang murah bisa terkena pembatasan laju.

settings.llm.apiKey.desc.cloud.original: Stored in Obsidian secret storage, not in plugin data.
settings.llm.apiKey.desc.cloud.translation: Disimpan di penyimpanan rahasia Obsidian, bukan di data plugin.

settings.llm.apiKey.desc.ollama.original: Server URL, stored in plugin data.
settings.llm.apiKey.desc.ollama.translation: URL server, disimpan di data plugin.

settings.llm.model.desc.original: Select a preset model or type a custom model name below.
settings.llm.model.desc.translation: Pilih model bawaan atau ketik nama model kustom di bawah.

settings.llm.modelParams.descCustom.original: Required: this model isn't in the registry — set context window, max output, and reserve % so token budgeting can size requests safely.
settings.llm.modelParams.descCustom.translation: Wajib: model ini tidak ada di registri — atur jendela konteks, keluaran maksimum, dan persen cadangan agar penganggaran token bisa menakar ukuran permintaan dengan aman.

settings.llm.modelParams.descOverride.original: These are this model's token limits, prefilled from known data. Edit a field to override it for this provider and model.
settings.llm.modelParams.descOverride.translation: Ini batas token model tersebut, terisi otomatis dari data yang diketahui. Ubah salah satu isian untuk menimpanya bagi penyedia dan model ini.

settings.llm.contextWindow.desc.original: Total context window in thousands of tokens (e.g., 400 for 400k tokens)
settings.llm.contextWindow.desc.translation: Total jendela konteks dalam ribuan token (mis. 400 untuk 400k token)

settings.llm.maxOutput.desc.original: Maximum output tokens in thousands (e.g., 128 for 128k tokens)
settings.llm.maxOutput.desc.translation: Jumlah token keluaran maksimum dalam ribuan (mis. 128 untuk 128k token)

settings.llm.inputMax.desc.original: Explicit input cap if vendor publishes one (leave empty to auto calculate)
settings.llm.inputMax.desc.translation: Batas masukan eksplisit bila vendor mengumumkannya (kosongkan untuk hitung otomatis)

settings.llm.reservePct.desc.original: Safety reserve for output tokens (0.10 = 10%, default: {default})
settings.llm.reservePct.desc.translation: Cadangan aman untuk token keluaran (0.10 = 10%, bawaan: {default})

settings.llm.temperature.desc.original: Controls randomness of output (0-1). Lower is more focused, higher is more creative. Current value: {value}
settings.llm.temperature.desc.translation: Mengatur keacakan keluaran (0-1). Makin rendah makin terarah, makin tinggi makin kreatif. Nilai saat ini: {value}

settings.noteFormat.prependDate.name.translation: Tambahkan tanggal di depan judul catatan

settings.noteFormat.prependDate.desc.original: Automatically add date to the beginning of note filenames
settings.noteFormat.prependDate.desc.translation: Otomatis menambahkan tanggal di awal nama berkas catatan

settings.noteFormat.dateFormat.desc.original: Format for date prepended to note titles
settings.noteFormat.dateFormat.desc.translation: Format tanggal yang ditaruh di depan judul catatan

settings.prompts.systemFast.desc.original: Instructions for the llms behavior when generating fast summaries
settings.prompts.systemFast.desc.translation: Instruksi untuk perilaku model bahasa saat membuat ringkasan cepat

settings.prompts.userFast.desc.original: Specific instructions for summarizing the transcript quickly and concisely
settings.prompts.userFast.desc.translation: Instruksi khusus untuk meringkas transkrip secara cepat dan ringkas

settings.prompts.userFast.placeholder.original: Please summarize the following YouTube transcript...

settings.prompts.systemExtensive.desc.original: Instructions for the llms behavior when generating detailed, comprehensive summaries
settings.prompts.systemExtensive.desc.translation: Instruksi untuk perilaku model bahasa saat membuat ringkasan yang rinci dan menyeluruh

settings.prompts.userExtensive.desc.original: Specific instructions for creating detailed and structured notes from the transcript
settings.prompts.userExtensive.desc.translation: Instruksi khusus untuk membuat catatan yang rinci dan terstruktur dari transkrip

settings.prompts.userExtensive.placehold.original: From the transcript below, create detailed and structured notes...
settings.prompts.userExtensive.placehold.translation: Dari transkrip di bawah ini, buat catatan yang rinci dan terstruktur…

settings.prompts.defaultMode.desc.original: Choose the default summary mode to use when the plugin starts. Fast summary mode skips timestamp links for quicker processing.
settings.prompts.defaultMode.desc.translation: Pilih mode ringkasan yang dipakai saat plugin mulai berjalan. Mode ringkasan cepat melewati tautan stempel waktu agar pemrosesan lebih gesit.

settings.prompts.timestampLinks.desc.original: Add links to each numbered section heading that jump to the corresponding timestamp in the YouTube video (note: disabled in fast summary mode)
settings.prompts.timestampLinks.desc.translation: Tambahkan tautan pada tiap judul bagian bernomor yang melompat ke stempel waktu terkait di video YouTube (catatan: mati di mode ringkasan cepat)

settings.prompts.timestampLinks.infoTool.original: When enabled, reduces first pass tokens by 12% to make room for links. Automatically disabled in fast summary mode.
settings.prompts.timestampLinks.infoTool.translation: Saat aktif, token babak pertama dipangkas 12% untuk memberi ruang bagi tautan. Otomatis mati di mode ringkasan cepat.

settings.advanced.info.original: Advanced settings for debugging and troubleshooting. Enable debug logging to get detailed information appended to each note for technical support.
settings.advanced.info.translation: Pengaturan lanjutan untuk debug dan penelusuran masalah. Aktifkan log debug agar keterangan rinci ditempelkan pada tiap catatan untuk dukungan teknis.

settings.advanced.debugLogging.desc.original: Enable detailed debug logs. When enabled, debug information will be appended to each note as a hidden callout for troubleshooting.
settings.advanced.debugLogging.desc.translation: Aktifkan log debug yang rinci. Saat aktif, keterangan debug ditempelkan pada tiap catatan sebagai callout tersembunyi untuk penelusuran masalah.

settings.advanced.debugLogging.infoToolt.original: When enabled, debug information will be collected and added to notes as a hidden callout instead of being logged to the console.
settings.advanced.debugLogging.infoToolt.translation: Saat aktif, keterangan debug dikumpulkan dan ditambahkan ke catatan sebagai callout tersembunyi, bukan dicetak ke konsol.

license.modal.loadError.original: Could not load license file. Please check that a license file exists in your plugin directory.
license.modal.loadError.translation: Berkas lisensi tidak bisa dimuat. Periksa apakah berkas lisensi ada di direktori plugin Anda.

license.required.message.original: You must accept the plugin license before using this feature.
license.required.message.translation: Anda harus menerima lisensi plugin sebelum memakai fitur ini.

license.required.instruction.original: Please go to the plugin settings and accept the license terms to continue.
license.required.instruction.translation: Silakan buka pengaturan plugin dan terima ketentuan lisensi untuk melanjutkan.

license.required.step2.original: Scroll down to the "Community Plugins" section in the sidebar
license.required.step2.translation: Gulir ke bawah sampai bagian plugin komunitas di bilah sisi

license.required.step3.original: Find "Tubesage" in the Community Plugins list

license.required.step5.original: Toggle "Accept license & disclaimer" to enable the plugin
license.required.step5.translation: Nyalakan “Terima lisensi dan penafian” untuk mengaktifkan plugin

notice.apiKey.missing.original: Youtube transcript plugin: no API key configured for {provider}. Add your API key in the plugin settings.
notice.apiKey.missing.translation: Plugin transkrip Youtube: belum ada kunci API untuk {provider}. Tambahkan kunci API Anda di pengaturan plugin.

notice.job.interrupted.original: Processing was interrupted; resume it from "Show active jobs"
notice.job.interrupted.translation: Pemrosesan terhenti; lanjutkan dari “Tampilkan pekerjaan aktif”

notice.debugNote.created.original: Error note created with debug information: {file}
notice.debugNote.created.translation: Catatan kesalahan dengan informasi debug dibuat: {file}

notice.debugNote.failed.original: Error: {error} (Also failed to create debug note)

notice.recovery.checkFailed.original: Could not check for interrupted jobs: {error}
notice.recovery.checkFailed.translation: Tidak bisa memeriksa tugas yang terhenti: {error}

notice.transcript.noTimestamps.original: Warning: No timestamps found in transcript. Timestamps are required for proper processing.
notice.transcript.noTimestamps.translation: Peringatan: tidak ada stempel waktu dalam transkrip. Stempel waktu diperlukan untuk pemrosesan.

notice.templater.required.original: Error: Templater plugin is required but not installed or enabled
notice.templater.required.translation: Kesalahan: plugin Templater diperlukan tetapi belum dipasang atau diaktifkan

notice.templater.missing.original: Youtube transcript plugin requires the Templater plugin. Please install and enable it.
notice.templater.missing.translation: Plugin transkrip Youtube memerlukan plugin Templater. Pasang dan aktifkan plugin itu.

notice.collection.safetyLimit.original: Reached safety limit of {limit} videos. Processing the first {limit} videos.
notice.collection.safetyLimit.translation: Batas aman {limit} video tercapai. Yang diproses adalah {limit} video pertama.

notice.timestamps.adding.translation: Menambahkan tautan stempel waktu dengan LLM...

notice.timestamps.retrying.translation: Mencoba lagi dengan batas token lebih kecil...

notice.timestamps.added.original: Added timestamp links to {count} section headings
notice.timestamps.added.translation: Tautan stempel waktu ditambahkan ke {count} judul bagian

notice.translate.emptyResponse.original: Failed to translate content (empty response from LLM)
notice.translate.emptyResponse.translation: Gagal menerjemahkan konten (respons kosong dari LLM)

notice.models.apiKeyMissing.original: {provider} API key is missing. Cannot fetch models.
notice.models.apiKeyMissing.translation: Kunci API {provider} tidak ada. Model tidak dapat diambil.

notice.models.parseFailed.original: Could not parse {provider} models from API response.
notice.models.parseFailed.translation: Model {provider} tidak dapat dibaca dari respons API.

notice.timestamps.addedChunked.original: Added {count} timestamp links using chunked processing
notice.timestamps.addedChunked.translation: Menambahkan {count} tautan stempel waktu dengan pemrosesan bertahap

modal.create.titlePlaceholder.original: Leave empty to use YouTube title

modal.create.urlInvalid.original: Not a valid YouTube URL. Only video, playlist, and channel urls are supported.
modal.create.urlInvalid.translation: Bukan URL YouTube yang valid. Hanya URL video, daftar putar, dan kanal yang didukung.

modal.create.title.original: Tubesage: create note from YouTube transcript
modal.create.title.translation: Tubesage: buat catatan dari transkrip YouTube

modal.create.urlPlaylist.original: YouTube channel or playlist URL detected
modal.create.urlPlaylist.translation: Terdeteksi URL kanal atau daftar putar YouTube

modal.create.videoCountPrompt.original: How many videos would you like to process? Max hard limit is 50.
modal.create.videoCountPrompt.translation: Berapa banyak video yang ingin diproses? Batas maksimumnya 50.

modal.create.fastModeDesc.original: Enable for shorter, quicker summaries (skips timestamp links)
modal.create.fastModeDesc.translation: Ringkasan lebih singkat dan cepat (melewati tautan stempel waktu)

modal.jobs.loadError.original: Could not read the job list: {error}

modal.jobs.discardHint.original: Discard removes a job from this list; it never deletes notes.
modal.jobs.discardHint.translation: Buang hanya menghapus tugas dari daftar ini; catatan tidak pernah dihapus.

modal.templatePicker.empty.original: No template files found in "{folder}" folder. Make sure your template folder is correctly configured in Templater settings.
modal.templatePicker.empty.translation: Tidak ada berkas templat di folder “{folder}”. Pastikan folder templat sudah diatur dengan benar di pengaturan Templater.

modal.readme.loadError.original: Could not load readme file. Please check that readme.md exists in your plugin directory.
modal.readme.loadError.translation: Tidak dapat memuat berkas readme. Pastikan readme.md ada di folder plugin.

modal.template.title.original: Example template: copy and place in your templater plugin specified template directory
modal.template.title.translation: Contoh templat: salin ke folder templat yang diatur di Templater

modal.template.explanation.original: This is the example templater plugin template used for YouTube transcript notes. You can customize this template for your own needs.
modal.template.explanation.translation: Ini adalah contoh templat Templater untuk catatan transkrip YouTube. Kamu bisa menyesuaikannya dengan kebutuhanmu.

modal.template.loadError.original: Could not load template file. Please check that the template exists in your plugin directory or vault templates folder.
modal.template.loadError.translation: Tidak dapat memuat berkas templat. Pastikan berkas ada di folder plugin atau folder templat brankas.

notice.collection.addingTimestamps.playl.original: Adding timestamp links to playlist video: {title}
notice.collection.addingTimestamps.playl.translation: Menambahkan tautan stempel waktu ke video daftar putar: {title}

notice.collection.addingTimestamps.chann.original: Adding timestamp links to channel video: {title}
notice.collection.addingTimestamps.chann.translation: Menambahkan tautan stempel waktu ke video kanal: {title}

notice.collection.timestampsFailed.original: Note created but timestamps could not be added to "{title}"
notice.collection.timestampsFailed.translation: Catatan dibuat, tetapi stempel waktu tidak dapat ditambahkan ke “{title}”

notice.collection.complete.original: Channel processing complete: {processed} processed, {skipped} skipped, {errors} errors
notice.collection.complete.translation: Pemrosesan kanal selesai – diproses: {processed}, dilewati: {skipped}, kesalahan: {errors}

notice.job.saveFailed.original: Could not save the job: {error}. The video may still be processing; check "Show active jobs"
notice.job.saveFailed.translation: Tidak dapat menyimpan tugas: {error}. Video mungkin masih diproses; lihat “Tampilkan pekerjaan aktif”

notice.job.alreadyRunning.original: This video is already being processed

notice.job.cannotResume.original: This job cannot be resumed as it is; see its status
notice.job.cannotResume.translation: Tugas ini tidak dapat dilanjutkan dalam keadaan ini; lihat statusnya

notice.job.cannotFinish.original: This job cannot be finished as it is; see its status
notice.job.cannotFinish.translation: Tugas ini tidak dapat diselesaikan dalam keadaan ini; lihat statusnya

modal.template.var.title.desc.original: - The title of the Youtube video

modal.template.var.videoUrl.desc.original: - The URL of the Youtube video

modal.template.var.summary.desc.original: - The LLM-generated summary of the video

modal.template.var.llmProvider.desc.original: - The LLM provider used (e.g., openai, anthropic)
modal.template.var.llmProvider.desc.translation: - Penyedia LLM yang dipakai (mis. openai, anthropic)

modal.template.var.llmModel.desc.original: - The specific model used (e.g., gpt-4, claude-3-opus)
modal.template.var.llmModel.desc.translation: - Model spesifik yang dipakai (mis. gpt-4, claude-3-opus)

modal.template.var.llmTags.desc.original: - Tags generated from the LLM provider and model
modal.template.var.llmTags.desc.translation: - Tag yang dibuat dari penyedia dan model LLM

notice.models.providerSet.original: Provider set to {provider}. Output budget: {tokens} tokens (max output minus reserve).
notice.models.providerSet.translation: Penyedia disetel ke {provider}. Anggaran keluaran: {tokens} token (keluaran maksimum dikurangi cadangan).

notice.models.modelChanged.original: Model changed to {model}. Output budget: {tokens} tokens (max output minus reserve).
notice.models.modelChanged.translation: Model diubah ke {model}. Anggaran keluaran: {tokens} token (keluaran maksimum dikurangi cadangan).

notice.models.refreshFailed.original: Could not refresh {provider} models. Using existing list.
notice.models.refreshFailed.translation: Tidak dapat menyegarkan model {provider}. Daftar yang ada tetap dipakai.

notice.collection.noVideos.playlist.original: No videos found in this playlist
notice.collection.noVideos.playlist.translation: Tidak ada video yang ditemukan di daftar putar ini

notice.collection.noVideos.channel.original: No videos found in this channel
notice.collection.noVideos.channel.translation: Tidak ada video yang ditemukan di kanal ini

notice.models.refreshedWithLimits.other.original: {provider} model list refreshed. Token limits auto-populated for {count} models.
notice.models.refreshedWithLimits.other.translation: Daftar model {provider} disegarkan. Batas token diisi otomatis untuk {count} model.

modal.jobs.closed.noNote.original: Interrupted when Obsidian closed; no note was created
modal.jobs.closed.noNote.translation: Terhenti saat Obsidian ditutup; tidak ada catatan yang dibuat

modal.jobs.closed.mayExist.original: Interrupted when Obsidian closed; a note may exist at {path}
modal.jobs.closed.mayExist.translation: Terhenti saat Obsidian ditutup; mungkin ada catatan di {path}

modal.jobs.closed.withoutTimestamps.original: Interrupted when Obsidian closed; the note was created without timestamps
modal.jobs.closed.withoutTimestamps.translation: Terhenti saat Obsidian ditutup; catatan dibuat tanpa stempel waktu

modal.jobs.closed.withoutTranslation.original: Interrupted when Obsidian closed; the note was created without translation
modal.jobs.closed.withoutTranslation.translation: Terhenti saat Obsidian ditutup; catatan dibuat tanpa terjemahan

modal.jobs.reason.paidStageInFlight.original: Interrupted during {stage}; the previous request may already have been billed
modal.jobs.reason.paidStageInFlight.translation: Terhenti saat {stage}; permintaan sebelumnya mungkin sudah ditagih

modal.jobs.reason.unknownBilling.original: Interrupted during {stage}; billing for the previous request is unknown
modal.jobs.reason.unknownBilling.translation: Terhenti saat {stage}; tidak diketahui apakah permintaan sebelumnya ditagih

modal.jobs.reason.noteCollision.original: A note already exists at the target path — rename or remove it, then resume from Show active jobs
modal.jobs.reason.noteCollision.translation: Sudah ada catatan di jalur tujuan — ubah namanya atau hapus, lalu lanjutkan dari “Tampilkan pekerjaan aktif”

modal.jobs.reason.claimUnresolved.original: Could not confirm whether the note at the target path belongs to this job
modal.jobs.reason.claimUnresolved.translation: Tidak dapat memastikan apakah catatan di jalur tujuan milik pekerjaan ini

modal.jobs.reason.noteMissing.original: The note for this job was moved or deleted
modal.jobs.reason.noteMissing.translation: Catatan pekerjaan ini telah dipindahkan atau dihapus

modal.jobs.reason.noteChanged.original: The note was edited during processing; timestamps were skipped
modal.jobs.reason.noteChanged.translation: Catatan disunting saat pemrosesan; stempel waktu dilewati

modal.jobs.reason.templaterUnavailable.original: Templater is not available; enable it, then resume
modal.jobs.reason.templaterUnavailable.translation: Templater tidak tersedia; aktifkan, lalu lanjutkan

modal.jobs.reason.paidRefetch.original: Resuming re-fetches the transcript through a paid service
modal.jobs.reason.paidRefetch.translation: Melanjutkan akan mengambil ulang transkrip lewat layanan berbayar

modal.jobs.reason.pathDrift.original: The note path could not be computed consistently (check folder and date settings), then resume
modal.jobs.reason.pathDrift.translation: Jalur catatan tidak dapat dihitung secara konsisten (periksa pengaturan folder dan tanggal), lalu lanjutkan

notice.note.done.timestampsEdited.original: Note created, but timestamps were skipped because the note was edited
notice.note.done.timestampsEdited.translation: Catatan dibuat, tetapi stempel waktu dilewati karena catatan disunting

notice.note.done.translationEdited.original: Note created, but the translation was skipped because the note was edited
notice.note.done.translationEdited.translation: Catatan dibuat, tetapi terjemahan dilewati karena catatan disunting

notice.note.done.bothEdited.original: Note created, but timestamps and the translation were skipped because the note was edited
notice.note.done.bothEdited.translation: Catatan dibuat, tetapi stempel waktu dan terjemahan dilewati karena catatan disunting

notice.note.done.withoutBoth.original: Note created without timestamps or translation
notice.note.done.withoutBoth.translation: Catatan dibuat tanpa stempel waktu dan tanpa terjemahan

notice.coldStart.single.noNote.original: TubeSage: 1 note job was interrupted when Obsidian closed — {title}: no note was created
notice.coldStart.single.noNote.translation: TubeSage: 1 pekerjaan catatan terhenti saat Obsidian ditutup — {title}: tidak ada catatan yang dibuat

notice.coldStart.single.mayExist.original: TubeSage: 1 note job was interrupted when Obsidian closed — {title}: a note may exist at {path}
notice.coldStart.single.mayExist.translation: TubeSage: 1 pekerjaan catatan terhenti saat Obsidian ditutup — {title}: mungkin ada catatan di {path}

notice.coldStart.single.withoutTimestamp.original: TubeSage: 1 note job was interrupted when Obsidian closed — {title}: note was created without timestamps
notice.coldStart.single.withoutTimestamp.translation: TubeSage: 1 pekerjaan catatan terhenti saat Obsidian ditutup — {title}: catatan dibuat tanpa stempel waktu

notice.coldStart.single.withoutTranslati.original: TubeSage: 1 note job was interrupted when Obsidian closed — {title}: note was created without translation
notice.coldStart.single.withoutTranslati.translation: TubeSage: 1 pekerjaan catatan terhenti saat Obsidian ditutup — {title}: catatan dibuat tanpa terjemahan

notice.coldStart.several.original: TubeSage: {count} note jobs were interrupted when Obsidian closed; the most recent are listed under Show active jobs
notice.coldStart.several.translation: TubeSage: {count} pekerjaan catatan terhenti saat Obsidian ditutup; yang terbaru tercantum di “Tampilkan pekerjaan aktif”

notice.recovery.single.translation: TubeSage: 1 pekerjaan yang terhenti perlu ditangani

notice.recovery.several.translation: TubeSage: {count} pekerjaan yang terhenti perlu ditangani

common.transcript.unavailable.original: No transcript is available for this video
common.transcript.unavailable.translation: Transkrip tidak tersedia untuk video ini
